items.scheme_name: Supporting Community Radio Movement in India
items.question: What is the financial assistance provided under the Supporting Community Radio Movement in India scheme for?
items.reference_answer: The financial assistance is provided once the Community Radio Station (CRS) is made operational by the Licensee.
items.evidence_quote: Financial assistance is provided once the CRS is made operational by Licensee.
items.closest_faq: Who Can apply for financial assistance.

items.scheme_name: Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry
items.question: What documents are required for the Production Linked Incentive Scheme For Automobile And Auto Component Industry application?
items.reference_answer: The required documents include Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum & Articles of Association, PAN Card, Import Export Code (IEC) Registration Certificate, and a Letter of Authorization by Board of Directors or Managing Director.
items.evidence_quote: Certificate of Incorporation (Issued by ROC); Memorandum & Articles of Association (Submitted to ROC); PAN Card; Import Export Code (IEC) Registration Certificate; Letter of Authorization by Board of Directors or Managing Director or Equivalent (incl. subsidiary(ies));
items.closest_faq: What are the circumstances under which an applicant may be ineligible for the scheme?

items.scheme_name: National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme
items.question: What is the minimum percentage required for post-graduation in the National Centre for Communication Security (NCCS) Research Associates Scheme?
items.reference_answer: The minimum percentage required for post-graduation is 60%.
items.evidence_quote: Post-Graduation/ Master Degree in Electronics/ Communications/Telecommunications/ Information Technology/ Computers or related discipline with minimum 60% marks (with valid Gate Score at the time of admission).
items.closest_faq: What is the methodology for shortlisting of candidates?

items.scheme_name: Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)
items.question: What is the process to apply for the Financial Support To The Students Of N.E.R For Higher Professional Courses (NEC Merit Scholarship)?
items.reference_answer: The application process involves registering on the National Scholarship Portal, creating an application ID and password, logging in, and filling out the application form with required details and document uploads.
items.evidence_quote: Step 1: Go to [http://www.scholarships.gov.in/]() and click “New Registration”. | Guidelines for Registration will appear. Scroll to the bottom. | Read carefully the undertaking. Accept the Terms. Click “Continue”. | Step 2: A Registration Form will appear. (The fields marked as are compulsory) | Fill the details and click “Register”. | Your Application ID and password will be displayed. | The same will also be sent as an SMS on your registered mobile number.
items.closest_faq: What Is The Criterion For Selection Of Students For Scholarships?

items.scheme_name: ICRO Amrit Internship Programme

items.reference_answer: The selected intern is entitled to ₹ 6,000 per month as a stipend during the internship period.

items.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram
items.question: What is the condition for a project to be considered under Pradhan Mantri Jan vikas karyakram?
items.reference_answer: The project area must have a minority population of more than 25% within a 15Km radius catchment area.
items.evidence_quote: The projects under PMJVK can be proposed in the identified areas as approved and certified by the SLC (where the minority population is more than 25% of the total population in the catchment area - 15Km radius).
items.closest_faq: What is the Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK)?

items.scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates
items.question: What is the requirement for a candidate to be eligible for the Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship For Scheduled Caste Candidates?
items.reference_answer: The candidate must belong to SC/ST and have passed the Post Graduate Examination. They must also be registered for M.Phil./Ph.D.

items.reference_answer: The required documents include a valid Email ID, preferably a NIC Email ID; service details of the officers; mobile number; proof of achievements (if any); a signed copy of the undertaking; and any other documents as required for the programme.

items.scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
items.question: What is the process to register a beneficiary under Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin?
items.reference_answer: To register a beneficiary, visit the PMAY-G official website, fill in personal details, upload the Aadhaar consent form, search for the beneficiary, select to register, and fill in remaining details like ownership type and bank account information.

items.scheme_name: Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Water Augmentation
items.question: What is the maximum subsidy amount a beneficiary can receive under the Development Support for Coffee in Traditional Areas: Water Augmentation scheme?
items.reference_answer: The maximum subsidy amount a beneficiary can receive is ₹2,50,000 per beneficiary for all components under the water augmentation scheme.

items.scheme_name: Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group
items.question: How can I track my application for the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme for Middle Income Group?
items.reference_answer: The applicant can track their application by visiting the CLAP Portal, entering the Application ID received via SMS, and entering the OTP code sent to their registered mobile number.
items.evidence_quote: Step 01: Applicant will visit CLAP Portal. | Step 02: On the Home Page, there is CLSS tracker, where the applicant will enter the Application ID as received through SMS from CLAP. | Step 03: On entering of valid Application ID, the system will send an OTP code on the mobile numbers of the applicant as registered in CLAP Portal during Process-1 through PLIs.

items.scheme_name: National Energy Conservation Award

items.reference_answer: The registration steps include visiting the official website, clicking the Registration button, selecting Individual or Organization, filling in required details, and clicking Submit.
items.evidence_quote: Step 1: Visit the official website and click on the Registration button. | Step 2: Select your category: Individual or Organization. | Step 3: Fill in the required details: | Individual: Name, Date of Birth, Nominator Type, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. | Organization: Type, Authorized Person Name, Date of Birth, Organization Description, Designation, Mobile, Email, Aadhaar Number. | Step 4: Click Submit to complete registration.

items.reference_answer: Yes, the cost of a long lease or rental workshed can be included in the project cost, but the lease rental should be for a maximum period of 3 years.

items.reference_answer: The total token stipend is ₹10,000/-, paid in two installments of ₹5,000/- each.
items.evidence_quote: A token stipend of ₹10,000/- (consolidated) @ ₹5,000/- per month would be paid to the selected intern on successful completion of his /her internship, at the end of the internship period.
